description: Retrieves detailed information for an existing Stripe product using its unique product ID. Use when you need to fetch details about a specific product.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for retrieving a specific product by ID.

expand.description: Specifies which fields in the response should be expanded. Supports nested expansions using dot notation (e.g., 'default_price'). Maximum depth of four levels.

id.description: The unique identifier of the product to retrieve. This ID typically starts with 'prod_'.
